questions.q: In a bicep curl the elbow is the fulcrum, the biceps pulls between the elbow and the hand. What class of lever is this?
questions.why: The effort is between the fulcrum and the load: third class.

questions.q: A cartwheel happens in which plane and about which axis?
questions.why: Sideways movement is in the frontal plane about the sagittal axis.

questions.q: Effort arm = 6 cm, load arm = 3 cm. What is the mechanical advantage?
Explain why a mechanical advantage of less than 1 is useful in sport, even though more effort is needed.
questions.model: A mechanical advantage below 1 means a short effort arm, so the limb moves quickly and through a large range of movement, e.g. a fast arm swing when throwing or kicking, although more muscular force is needed.
points: gives speed and range of movement, with example
